description.value: Prairie Inn Neighbourhood Pub is a community-oriented pub on East Saanich Road in the Saanich Peninsula, serving pub fare centred on burgers. Sitting along a popular cycling corridor connecting Sidney to Central Saanich, it offers a familiar neighbourhood atmosphere that touring cyclists passing through the area are likely to appreciate.
